title: SignTextGenerator
description: A plugin that alows you to make big text on signs easiely
body:
## A simple tool to generate big sign texts #### Developed for [BTE Germany](https://bte-germany.de/de) \([GitHub](https://github.com/BTE-Germany)\).

Font "signletters" by Hugleton # Usage: You need to be in creative mode to use the command.
``/givesign ``
You may need to adjust some characters by hand, depending on the combination # Adding fonts: Visit [the GitHub Repository](https://github.com/realMorgon/SignTextGenerator) for a guide.
